description: Upon entering the vault, the document pouch was found empty, the seal was forged, a size 43 shoe print was discovered, investigation pinpointed suspect Arthur Haddin, confirmed his sudden flight on June 30th, Russian dossier appeared

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled in many areas.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "He's been missing for several days. There might not be much useful information left at his home. Since he's so interested in supernatural and Nazi-related things, perhaps we should first look into the lectures he attended. We might get more information that way," Alison suggested.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled in many areas.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I have a feeling this trip won't be very safe. We might need some means of self-defense. I hope we can get the Deputy's support in this regard."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You decide not to rashly activate the headquarters' top-secret safe house for now, and instead head to the local safe house prepared by the Frankfurt station.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew gets behind the wheel of the small car, hoping he's already familiar enough with the local road rules.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Stay alert on the way to the safe house to see if we're being followed.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Carefully drive the other sedan, following behind Andrew.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Used to Britain's unique right-hand drive cars, driving a left-hand drive car feels a bit novel for the first time. However, it doesn't hinder the trained agents. After a brief familiarization, you all hit the road with ease.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I feel like there's a car following us. The driver looks somewhat familiar."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David memorizes the city map along the way, separately planning escape routes to both safe houses.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew drives while occasionally glancing at the small mirror above.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Driving a left-hand drive car always feels a bit awkward. God forbid we get into a traffic accident."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David checks the following car through the rearview mirror.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Treat Andrew's car as the target, sticking close to it in the traffic flow. "Consider it practice."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You remain tense the whole way, but fortunately, nothing unexpected happens, and you arrive safely at the local Frankfurt safe house.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Drive steadily towards the destination, showing off some driving skills along the way, putting on a little show for the colleague following behind.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The safe house is located in an ordinary residential area. From the outside, it looks like a typical detached villa.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew parks the car by the roadside.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David hopes that by the end of this drive, he'll have memorized the entire city map, including the alleys.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I'll wait in the car. Call me if anything comes up, in German, of course."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ganz vorsichtig, mann."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: After getting out of the car, look around to assess the situation, then follow towards the safe house.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Park at a street corner farther from Andrew, keep watch on the surroundings from inside the car, and wait for them to retrieve the items.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Everything around seems normal. July 4th is a Tuesday, a weekday afternoon in a residential area with little pedestrian traffic.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew decides to read some leisure books in the car, like that book on information science (or pseudoscience) he just found, which was completely incomprehensible at first glance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Enter the house to retrieve the items.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David and Gray enter the safe house one after the other, quickly familiarize themselves with the interior layout, and locate the weapon storage.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: In the center of the safe house living room sits a brown leather multi-person sofa covered with a warm blanket. The walls are beige, decorated with simple paintings and family photos. The floor is covered with a brown carpet. The room also has a large wooden bookshelf holding a few books, magazines, and some ornaments. A black-and-white television sits in the corner, with a small statue placed on top of it.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Take out that Russian document, study it while occasionally glancing around with peripheral vision.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Carefully open the hidden compartment and check the condition of the weapons.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Inside are 6 .45 caliber pistols with matching silencers and ammunition. Two .45 caliber submachine guns and ammunition. Two Lee-Enfield No.4 sniper rifles and ammunition.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew is a novice, having only fired pistols, and not even very proficiently at that.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: 2 grenades, 2 smoke grenades.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled at many things. <player5>'s personal attributes are: Shotgun: 25.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Four bundles of C4 explosives.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Did we receive sniper rifle training in agent training?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Medical supplies and equipment sufficient for minor surgical procedures, several common anesthetics, binoculars, camera and film, everyday hardware tools, lockpicking tools, dictionaries and shorthand cards in multiple languages, city street maps and underground pipeline maps.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Tuck two pistols behind the waist, disassemble the two submachine guns simply and stuff them into a bag found in the house—a tennis racket bag would be better. Put a bundle of C4 into a clothes pocket. Also take ammunition, leaving the sniper rifles untouched by David.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Moreover, deep in the hidden compartment is a secret door; passing through it leads to a secret passage that connects directly to the city's sewer system.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The firepower is sufficient; I hope we won't need to use it."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player6>'s Computer Use check result: D100=54/40 Failure. Sorry, I just had an itch to try, didn't expect to make you fail.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Take another pistol and ammunition, concealed under the trench coat, this is for Andrew.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The mountains and soil listen to your wishes; whatever the causes and karmic retribution, fate already slumbers in your palm. <player5>'s Russian check result: D100=26/60 Hard success. Copying books was indeed useful, trust my experience. <player5>'s Library Use check result: D100=98/20 Critical failure! Life's disappointments are nine out of ten, just ups and downs and downs... I meant to comfort you.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Can only flip back and forth, hoping to glean something from this half-understood text, but to no avail.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 still only understood the title.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Put the remaining three pistols with matching silencers and ammunition into the bag. Put the grenades and smoke grenades into inner coat pockets. Also take a bundle of C4. Prepare two backpacks, each containing a set of medical tools, lockpicking tools, camera, and binoculars.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Cyka blyat, what the hell is all this written?" Can't understand the mystical ramblings in the book at all, angrily slams the book shut with force.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "These things could cause quite a commotion; I hope we won't need to use them."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "I hope we don't encounter any police checks on the way." Let's go, get in the car!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Check the safe house's structure once more, pick up the bag, and return to Rabin's car.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Distribute the weapons.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The firepower is very ample, even including two sniper rifles and various explosives, plus plenty of other tools. The preparation is really thorough."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew takes a pistol. For the other items, he just looks at them enviously for a while.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then I'll switch with Alison; I'll go to Rabin's car and give him the C4, a pistol, and ammunition.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "They were surely prepared for more professional agents; never thought they'd be activated by us today."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Give him the silencer too.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: I'll carry two pistols, a smoke grenade hidden in an inner coat pocket, and a bag containing lockpicking tools, medical supplies, and pistol ammunition.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew also places the hardware tools under the driver's seat; they might come in handy later.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Forgot to mention, David takes the street maps and underground pipeline maps, as well as the camera and film.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Take the weapon passed over by David and put it away safely.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled at many things.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Give the items to Rabin, and David, read that book.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Russian check result:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Get in the car and settle down. Andrew first drives around the small town for a while, then heads to the target location.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Frankfurt, as a financial hub, naturally boasts prosperity no less than London's, with all kinds of high-end restaurants lining the streets. Your stomachs, having missed lunch, betray you with an untimely growl.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Should we get something to eat?" Andrew asks Ms. Gray in the passenger seat in a somewhat meek tone.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Of course, it's better to work on a full stomach," Alison is already used to Andrew's unique sense of humor. "You could also try learning some foreign dishes."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: At this very moment, David is still raging helplessly at the book.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then use the radio to discuss lunch arrangements with colleagues.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "We're out and about for once, let's find a decent place to try Frankfurt sausages and German pork knuckle."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew nods repeatedly while driving.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I don't have many requirements for food, just clean and hygienic is fine."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: His eyes are already searching for a restaurant with plenty of customers.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Folks, remember to stash the pieces in your pockets before heading to the restaurant."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Drive slowly following Andrew, occasionally scanning the storefronts and pedestrians along the street.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Check that the two pistols, fitted with silencers and fully loaded, are lying safely in the inner pockets of the clothes.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew looks down at his waist and abdomen, hoping nothing looks out of place, then immediately raises his head to look at the road.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Found a restaurant you like?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You recall Jackson mentioned an authentic place called Zum Gemalten Haus in Frankfurt's old town.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Shall we try our friend's recommendation?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Great, this is the one. Grateful to Jackson. Andrew feels he could listen to his chatter for a whole day without getting tired, Frankfurt is so novel.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's go."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Drive there.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Go.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Even though work hasn't started yet, one must always eat.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This restaurant lives up to its reputation. The locally brewed apple cider is perfectly balanced between sweet and sour, with a refreshing fruity aroma; the Frankfurt sausages are rich in fat but not greasy, with a delicate spice flavor that lingers pleasantly; the pork knuckle has a crispy, fragrant skin, yet the meat is extremely tender, almost easily cut without a knife and fork. Each bite of pork carries a rich meaty aroma, with fat permeating every fiber, making it a perfect match with beer.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Try hard to savor the food, guessing the ingredients and cooking techniques of the dishes.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Don't drink and drive, don't drive after drinking. Not to mention David is an Anglican priest. He doesn't drink alcohol.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This entire meal only cost 100 Marks, which is a drop in the bucket compared to the 3000 Mark budget.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew still wants to drink a little; a little drink makes driving steadier.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Elegantly using knife and fork to savor the delicacies, Alison, as a doctor, also dislikes drinking alcohol.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Make sure the four of them eat different foods to prevent poisoning all four at once from food poisoning.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As the saying goes, a full belly and warm clothes lead to thoughts of patriotism; after eating and drinking your fill, you are full of drive and ready to work hard for Great Britain.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: After finishing the meal, it's time to go back to work. Andrew enjoys this brief moment, thinking he'll find a way to replicate it later, making a monkey version.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Mmm, delicious 😋" German cuisine lives up to its reputation, making Rabin, who has suffered from British food, unable to help but eat heartily, relying only on willpower to maintain basic table manners.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Stay alert, everyone. There might still be accomplices near his residence; we should try not to make too much noise."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I could eat this place's pork knuckle and sausages for a month, no, three months."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew feels sorry for Rabin the driver.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Later, one car's people will go in to investigate, while the other car's people stay on standby to keep watch."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I'm really looking forward to it then."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew boldly boasts, even though he's only had one meal.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You previously learned from the consulate staff that Haddin's address is in the diplomatic apartment area.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: The diplomatic apartment area, just thinking about it is full of all sorts of strange creatures. Andrew braces himself with 120% focus, constantly smacking his lips, reminiscing about the taste of apple wine and pork knuckle.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "We better hide our gear well."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "It seems we don't even have keys; we'll have to get out and pick the lock... doesn't seem very wise."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You arrive at the entrance checkpoint of the diplomatic apartment area. You can see it's heavily armed with high security measures; even intelligence agency agents would find it difficult to infiltrate. This means it's very hard for outsiders to invade or blend in to surveil a building for a long time.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're good at quite a few things.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "This, this, should we drive further? I don't think it's very wise..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We have diplomatic status; entering and exiting here shouldn't be strange, right?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Do we?" Andrew is a bit flustered.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Yes, we do."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew steels himself and drives inside.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Otherwise, how did we come by plane?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "That just proves we entered legally. I thought only the leaders had diplomatic status..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After verifying your identities, security lets you through normally.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew drives toward Haddin's home. "When we get there, you all provide cover, and we'll pick the lock."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You continue driving to the B building apartment where Haddin lives.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Of course, it would be great if he left the key under the doormat; that would save us the trouble."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Drive in, park right next to Haddin's home, observe the surroundings, and after confirming no abnormalities, get out of the car.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Get off the car one after another with Rabin. After observing the surroundings, enter the apartment.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Keep an eye out for any suspicious individuals approaching while in the car.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Wait obediently in the driver's seat.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You enter the apartment lobby. The concierge looks like he has been waiting for a while.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hello, we are here under orders from the Foreign Ministry to search Haddin's residence." Show credentials.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "That's right, sorry to keep you waiting." Show credentials.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The lobby here is as normal as any apartment you've seen, with the concierge's desk on the right and a bulletin board beside it.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "When did Haddin leave?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: There's an elevator on the left and stairs ahead.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David, go call the other two over.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Understood," nods. "Has anyone else entered or left Haddin's room during that time?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Take the bag and enter the apartment.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "No," the concierge shakes his head.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Time to get to work. Andrew turns off the car and follows Ms. Gray upstairs.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Please take us inside to have a look."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Gives a slight nod, then walks to the bulletin board to examine its contents.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Of course, let me get the keys first. Please wait in the lobby for a moment." The concierge turns and enters the duty room.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David should be mindful of whether the concierge is lying.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: If there are windows here, Andrew will go look out of them, admiring the surrounding scenery.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: There is only one notice on the bulletin board at the moment.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "A spy who has been undercover for years suddenly withdrew on the 30th, without even having time to pack his things and materials. If it wasn't because of a risk of exposure at the embassy, then what could it be?" Thinks to himself while looking at the notice.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The diplomatic apartment's greenery is quite nice, but what's more noteworthy is the row of resident mailboxes by the windows.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Notice the resident mailboxes and go check if there are any letters left in Haddin's mailbox.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Walk to the resident mailboxes and open the one corresponding to Haddin.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Haddin's mailbox is locked.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Go to the duty room and ask the administrator if he has a mailbox key.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Shrugs and waits to ask the concierge for the key.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The concierge happens to come out of the duty room at this moment.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Can you open Haddin's mailbox?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The mailbox? I'm sorry, no. We place great emphasis on communication privacy here. Unless a resident specifically requests it, we do not keep backup keys for the mailboxes."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Then can we open it by other means?" Andrew asked the doorman in a faint voice. "We are all colleagues, and the consulate has approved it."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "But if you have other ways to open it, we won't stop you."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew looked at his colleagues, seeking their guidance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Take out lockpicking tools and prepare to pick the lock.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Locksmith check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The doorman looks very sincere.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Take a look at this," passing the letter to colleagues for them to read.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew frowned. So this guy was about to be purged and fled for his life, rather than being afraid of the truth coming out.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hmm? This is getting interesting now."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "What newspaper can investigate its own organization? That's too scary."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Then we should go check the apartment as soon as possible."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Take the keys and go to Haddin's apartment.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The doorman leads you to Haddin's room.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: After entering the room, first take out the bug detector and check each room.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David remembers to turn off the bug detector. Can't waste electricity.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Although the living room's decor and furniture meet middle-class standards, the owner of the house doesn't seem to have bothered with more upkeep. If not for the bookshelf full of books and some messy items on the coffee table, this would almost be an uninhabited showroom.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David goes to search the bedroom.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison heads straight for the bookshelf, scanning Haddin's book collection.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The bedroom furnishings are also very simple, with only a bed, wardrobe, nightstand, desk, and chair, equally plain.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Pick up those academic works and flip through them.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David searches every cabinet in the bedroom, including under the bed and between cabinet seams.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Nothing strange is hidden inside; the content is still about brain science and computer networks.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Judging by the letter's date, the June 30th phone call probably wasn't from that reporter. Haddin's newly discovered files likely haven't been sent out yet. If he fled in a hurry after the call, who was notifying him? This is more complicated than we initially thought."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Finding nothing from flipping through the books, look at the coffee table.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Go to the bathroom, check all drawers and cabinets, as well as the trash can and toilet.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: On the coffee table surface, besides tea sets, there is a silver badge with strange symbols. The ribbon below has a line of text: Thule Tradition Society.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Then Andrew goes to the kitchen; he's very familiar with this area.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes, he was working for some organization and received threats from within it. Based on his unique preference for black magic and Nazis, this organization probably researches these things too."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Education check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray recalls some knowledge about West German society and Jackson's introduction: The Thule Tradition Society is a neo-right-wing organization in post-war West Germany. They promote ideas like "Germany's WWII history has been smeared" and "Jews are actually guilty," and are considered a typical neo-Nazi organization. However, the organization itself is relatively loose, usually only engaging in protests and demonstrations, with occasional small-scale vandalism and crimes against foreigners, closely monitored by West German police.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Carefully take out these materials to read.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Mainly some correspondence, in which Haddin used a pseudonym to inquire about the activities and founders of the Thule Traditional Association. The association's replies were illogical and full of exaggeration. Haddin replied agreeing with their ideas, "could help them within his capabilities," and "combat those who slander Germany."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This guy is still supporting this neo-Nazi organization." Share your findings with colleagues.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "He seems a bit too curious."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Feels like some kind of sting operation." Andrew chimes in from the kitchen.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "From a spy's perspective, his interests are a bit too broad."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David is lying flat on the floor looking under the bed.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "What kind of spy gets involved with such hot potatoes? Even I know to avoid trouble. He must have other motives."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Check the various corners of the living room again, and the trash can.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: No other valuable items found.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Neo-Nazis, shamanism, computer and neuroscience, plus private investigations. Makes you wonder how many organizations he's really working for."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then wait for the teammates' findings.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player3 The wardrobe and bedside table are all normal.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Idea check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: While preparing to check the desk drawer, David feels the drawer is slightly harder to pull, as if the slide rails are rusty or connected to something.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David cautiously stops. He crawls under the desk to check the drawer slide rails, hoping it's not connected to a bomb.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Mechanical Repair check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: David can't figure it out.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Guys, anyone know mechanics? This drawer seems to have something." Call for backup.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew emerges from the kitchen, feeling summoned.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Bring lockpicking tools to the front of the drawer.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I know a little about gears too." Andrew squats down, but he yields the center position to the senior colleague.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Signal for Andrew to go ahead.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Mountains and soil listen to your hopes. Whatever the causes and effects, fate already slumbers in your palm.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David crawls out from under the desk.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Andrew didn't figure out what this thing is either.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Doesn't seem to be going smoothly. Andrew is sweating profusely; he's sweated too much today.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Seeing Andrew failed, Alison first tries to shake the drawer to feel where it's stuck, then pokes and prods the slide rails with tools, trying to find the key issue.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The cycle of fate is like shackles, and now you gamble on that untraceable chance?

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Any ideas?" Andrew looks at the senior colleague, one of his life mentors, full of expectation.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray noticed something unusual: a simple yet ingenious device was embedded in the drawer, connected to the inside of the drawer handle via a thin wire. Opening it recklessly would directly trigger the device, but the consequences of triggering it were unknown.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This is a trigger device. Opening it recklessly might activate the mechanism. I haven't managed to disarm it yet," Alison shook her head.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "If we can't open the drawer, how about opening the cabinet?" Andrew suggested boldly.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: @player6 "I think that's a good idea. Perhaps we can try opening this space from another angle."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "But that also carries significant risks, as we still don't understand how this thing works."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The cycle of fate is like shackles, and now you must gamble on that which leaves no trace?

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: The method worked.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Andrew changed his approach, easily dismantled the device, and retrieved the documents inside.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Well done, Schiller."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Medical report. The content of this report was: Arthur Haddin was in the late stages of cancer, and doctors recommended conservative treatment to prolong his life.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Couldn't have done it without the cultivation and guidance of all the leaders and colleagues..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Rental contract: a safe deposit box contract with Standard Bank. The lessee's name was Arthur Haddin, but there was no key.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "What is ODESSA?" Andrew asked curiously.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: None of you know anything about this.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I don't know either. Can anyone understand these letters?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "But it seems knowing what this thing is isn't particularly auspicious."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Another mysterious organization, one that existed since the Nazi era... ODESSA?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew shook his head vigorously.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Mountains and soil listen to your wishes. Regardless of the karma and retribution, fate already slumbers in your palm.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "So our Haddin has Russian friends too. How rare."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The handwriting is too scribbled; player5, accustomed to standard script, finds it a bit hard to read.
